findings.title: A mis-targeted native binary can be published, because the release path skips the arch/libc and load checks
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Verified arch/libc checks only in dispatch-only ffi-preflight.yml. The musl-links-glibc failure it describes later happened (#1002/#1018). Not KD-1/KD-2.

findings.title: The new gate job is a hard prerequisite for every JS release and Version PR update
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Gate is a hard prerequisite for release; loud, recoverable.

findings.title: Partial FFI release: npm packages published but tags, release or the dependent Stack publish missing
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Publish-before-tag ordering can leave a partial release; loud, recoverable.

case_note: Missed KD-1 (neon dist invocation) and KD-2 (grep -q under pipefail).
